questions.question: How should I lay out the new packages?

options.label: Workspace (Recommended)
options.description: One pnpm workspace with `apps/` and `packages/`. Shared tsconfig, one lockfile.

options.label: Single package
options.description: Everything in one `package.json`. Simplest, but the server bundle drags in Vue.

options.label: Separate repos
options.description: One repo per app. Versioning the protocol between them becomes your job.
